Tengen is a freestyle gomoku engine. These archives contain `pbrain-tengen`, a brain for [Piskvork](https://gomocup.org/download-gomocup-manager/) and other Gomocup managers (15×15 and 20×20 boards, freestyle rule).

To play in the browser instead, open the web version linked from the repository.

Check a download with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.
